name: Build PRIME MATH AI APK
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.22.3'
          channel: 'stable'
      - name: Create Project
        run: |
          flutter create . --project-name prime_math_ai --platforms=android --org com.prime.mathai
          cat > pubspec.yaml << 'PUBEOF'
name: prime_math_ai
description: PRIME MATH AI - Offline Prime Expert, Graphs, Pictures, Book Maker
publish_to: 'none'
version: 1.0.0+1
environment:
  sdk: ">=3.2.0 <4.0.0"
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  cupertino_icons: ^1.0.6
  path_provider: ^2.1.2
flutter:
  uses-material-design: true

PUBEOF
          mkdir -p lib
          echo "" | base64 -d > lib/main.dart
          flutter pub get
      - run: flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PRIME-MATH-AI-APK
          path: build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk
